reDerivedCrosswalk.countingRule: roll = every data row of the Orion property export (134,592). matched = rows whose key resolves in the stated txgio index. situsAgree = matched rows where norm(CAD Situs) == norm(txgio situs_address), norm = uppercase then delete every non-[A-Z0-9]. txgio index keeps the LOWEST feature_index on a duplicated key, mirroring the bake's ORDER BY feature_index + keep-first. A BLANK key is not a key and a BLANK-vs-BLANK situs comparison is NOT agreement.

byAccountClass.read: the PropertyNumber->geo_id path binds ONLY real-property accounts today, because TxGIO publishes parcels and P/M accounts have no parcel of their own. This is measured, not assumed, and the build does not depend on it: the ambiguity refusal is the guard, not the class letter.

reDerivedCrosswalk.whyPropertyNumberIsTheKEYandQuickRefIDIs: geo_id names a PARCEL and cannot collide across account classes; the QuickRefID stem is bare-numeric and its 5,214 surplus binds are exactly the numeric-collision class this whole defect is made of. Restricting the stem to R accounts is collision-free and would add 1,042 further binds (the R-only half of the 6,285 rows geo_id misses), and that is DECLINED: it buys 0.9 percent coverage by reintroducing a bare-numeric key whose safety rests on an Orion-specific account-class letter. Those 1,042 stay honest geometry absences. The stem is used ONLY as the second independent derivation.

theBuild.theMeaningShapedCHECK: the crosswalk bind requires TWO INDEPENDENTLY DERIVED identifiers to name the SAME txgio feature: property_number matched against txgio.geo_id, and the QuickRefID numeric stem matched against txgio.prop_id. Two different published columns on the CAD side, two different columns on the TxGIO side. When they name DIFFERENT features the bind is REFUSED and the row falls back to today's behaviour. Measured today: 115,035 corroborated, 0 refused. Zero refusals is reported as zero, not as proof of correctness; the branch is proven reachable by unit test.
theBuild.whatIsNOTinScope: land use. The crosswalk supplies the parcel ROW (ring, centroid, zoning stamp, feature identity). The address-recovery land-use path and its owner gate are untouched, because the mission is geometry and because that path feeds five other counties.
